name: Aussie Surfer Ltd
summary: This EA trades Bollinger Band mean reversion entries — buying when price penetrates below the lower band and selling when it penetrates above the upper band. Exits are managed by the Alligator indicator's Teeth line slope, closing longs when the Teeth are rising and shorts when falling. A trailing stop based on the previous bar's High/Low with the original Stop_Loss distance provides dynamic risk management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于布林带均值回归策略入场——价格穿透下轨时做多，穿透上轨时做空。出场由鳄鱼指标（Alligator）的牙齿线斜率管理，牙齿线上行时平多仓，下行时平空仓。基于前一根K线最高/最低价加上原始止损距离的移动止损提供动态风险管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念是布林带均值回归，利用价格偏离均线后回归的统计特性进行交易。入场条件为：当前柱开盘价跌破布林带下轨且前一根柱开盘价在下轨之上时做多；当前柱开盘价突破布林带上轨且前一根柱开盘价在上轨之下时做空。出场条件由鳄鱼指标的牙齿线（基线）斜率决定，如果持有多仓时牙齿线上升则平仓（趋势可能反转），持有空仓时牙齿线下降则平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数0.30手，不做加仓或减仓操作。资金管理方面设有46点固定止损和移动止损机制，移动止损基于前一根K线的最高/最低价加上止损距离来追踪，但止盈设为0即不使用固定止盈。策略依赖鳄鱼指标的趋势判断来决定出场时机，但出场逻辑存在矛盾——持多仓时牙齿线上行（看涨信号）反而平仓，这与常规趋势跟踪逻辑相悖。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is Bollinger Band mean reversion, exploiting the statistical tendency of prices to revert after deviating from the moving average. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the current bar's open price penetrates below the lower Bollinger Band while the previous bar's open was above it; a sell signal is generated when the current bar's open penetrates above the upper band while the previous bar's open was below it. Exit conditions are governed by the Alligator indicator's Teeth line (baseline) slope — counterintuitively, long positions are closed when the Teeth line is rising and short positions are closed when it is falling, which contradicts typical trend-following logic and suggests the EA closes when a new trend may be forming against the mean-reversion premise. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size of 0.30 with no scaling or martingale. Money management includes a 46-pip fixed stop loss and a trailing stop mechanism that tracks the previous bar's High/Low plus the original stop loss distance, but no fixed take profit is used. The trailing stop can also trigger a full position close if it reaches the current bid/ask price, effectively acting as a secondary exit mechanism.

parameters.description_en: Take profit in pips, 0 to disable

parameters.name: Magic_Number
parameters.description: 魔术编号，用于标识本EA的持仓
parameters.description_en: Magic number to identify EA positions

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，入场和出场条件明确，基于统计学原理的均值回归策略具有理论基础
包含完整的交易重试机制（4次重试）和订单校验（OrderCheck），以及自动填充模式切换，增强了交易执行的可靠性
移动止损机制基于前一根K线的极值动态调整，比固定止损更能适应市场波动
使用魔术编号区分持仓，避免与其他EA冲突，支持多EA并行运行
pros_en: Clear strategy logic with well-defined entry and exit conditions based on statistical mean reversion principles
Complete trade retry mechanism (4 retries) and order validation with automatic filling mode fallback, enhancing execution reliability
Trailing stop based on previous bar's High/Low dynamically adapts to market volatility better than fixed stops
Magic number isolates positions from other EAs, supporting multi-EA parallel operation
cons: 出场逻辑矛盾——持多仓时鳄鱼牙齿线上行（看涨信号）反而平仓，持空仓时牙齿线下行（看跌信号）反而平仓，与常规逻辑相悖
缺少点差过滤，均值回归策略在点差较大时容易因交易成本导致亏损，尤其在高频交易场景下风险更高
布林带周期仅5，非常短，容易产生大量虚假信号和过度交易
没有最大持仓限制或回撤控制，在连续亏损时没有保护机制
Take_Profit设为0意味着完全依赖指标出场和移动止损，可能导致盈利过早被回撤吃掉
cons_en: Contradictory exit logic — closing longs when Alligator Teeth are rising (bullish signal) and shorts when falling (bearish signal) defies conventional interpretation
No spread filter; mean reversion strategies are vulnerable to spread costs, especially problematic in high-spread environments
Bollinger Band period of only 5 is extremely short, likely generating excessive false signals and over-trading
No maximum position limit or drawdown control; no protection mechanism during consecutive losses
Take_Profit set to 0 means full reliance on indicator-based exit and trailing stop, which may allow profits to be eroded by adverse reversals
improvements: 增加点差过滤，当点差超过阈值时不入场，避免高交易成本侵蚀利润
修正鳄鱼指标出场逻辑——持多仓时应在牙齿线下降（趋势转弱）时平仓，而非上升时
增加最大回撤限制和每日最大交易次数限制，防止在极端行情中过度亏损
考虑增加更大的布林带周期选项或增加确认指标以减少虚假信号
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to skip entries when spread exceeds a threshold, preventing high trading costs from eroding profits
Fix the Alligator exit logic — close longs when the Teeth line is declining (weakening trend) rather than rising
Add maximum drawdown limit and daily maximum trade count to prevent excessive losses in extreme market conditions
Consider increasing the Bollinger Band period or adding a confirmation indicator to reduce false signals

risk_points: 出场逻辑与常规趋势判断相悖，可能导致策略在趋势形成时过早平仓或在不该持有时继续持有
布林带周期过短（5）容易产生过多交易信号，增加交易成本和滑点风险
无点差过滤，在高波动或低流动性时段入场可能因大点差直接亏损
移动止损在价格接近当前价时会触发全仓平仓，可能在正常波动中被误触发
risk_points_en: Exit logic contradicts conventional trend interpretation, potentially causing premature exits when trends form or holding positions when they shouldn't
Extremely short Bollinger Band period (5) generates excessive signals, increasing trading costs and slippage risk
No spread filter; entering during high volatility or low liquidity periods may result in immediate losses from wide spreads
Trailing stop triggers full position close when approaching current price, which may be falsely triggered during normal volatility
